e.title: **一个**自动跟随上游的镜像**：第 983 版、每天更新、**并把上游的解读告诫一起搬过来****：Kaggle 数据集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`——**⭐ 逐字副标题**「**Daily updates of the Economist covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**；**⭐ 它逐字保留上游的告诫**：**「**unless ranges are very narrow, the 95% range should be reported when possible**」**、**以及**「**Focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading**」**；**⭐ 并逐字写明**哪两个国家至今没有报告****；**⚠️ 体量在两个接口上给出**不一致**的数字（**10.45 GB 对 **2.85 GB****）**
e.title_en: An automatically updating mirror of an upstream excess-mortality model whose version counter stands at nine hundred and eighty-three, which carries the upstream interpretation warnings across with the data, says that central estimates are misleading unless the uncertainty range is narrow, and names the two countries that have never reported.
e.title_hk: **一個**自動跟隨上游的鏡像**：第 983 版、每天更新、**並把上游的解讀告誡一起搬過來****：Kaggle 資料集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`——**⭐ 逐字副標題**「**Daily updates of the Economist covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**；**⭐ 它逐字保留上游的告誡**：**「**unless ranges are very narrow, the 95% range should be reported when possible**」**、**以及**「**Focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading**」**；**⭐ 並逐字寫明**哪兩個國家至今沒有報告****；**⚠️ 體量在兩個介面上給出**不一致**的數字（**10.45 GB 對 **2.85 GB****）**
e.summary: **global-excess-deaths-mirror**（Kaggle 数据集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`）**是一份**自动跟随上游模型输出的**超额死亡每日镜像****——**逐字副标题为**「**Daily updates of the Economist的 Covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**，**并逐字给出上游仓库地址**（**`TheEconomist/covid-19-the-economist-global-excess-deaths-model`**）**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本号 **983****、**许可 **CC BY 4.0****、**可用性评分 **0.82****、**下载 **1,767 次、**浏览 **7,728 次、**收藏 **35**；**标签逐字含** `business`、`economics`、`time series analysis`、`global`、`covid19`、`diseases`、`mortality`**；**⚠️ 而**体量在两个接口上**不一致**（**数据集页给 **10,451,025,952 字节、**列表接口给约 **2.85 GB****）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：镜像**」**——**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **版本号 **983****（**⭐ 即**这不是一份快照，**而是一条**每天推进的线****）**；**② **上游的**解读告诫被一起搬过来****（**⭐ 包括**「**报告 95% 区间**」与**「**盯中心估计会误导**」**）**；**③ **逐字写明**哪两个国家从未报告****。**⚠️ 本次未下载任何文件、**未访问上游仓库。
e.summary_hk: **global-excess-deaths-mirror**（Kaggle 資料集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`）**是一份**自動跟隨上游模型輸出的**超額死亡每日鏡像****——**逐字副標題為**「**Daily updates of the Economist的 Covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**，**並逐字給出上游倉庫地址**（`TheEconomist/covid-19-the-economist-global-excess-deaths-model`**）**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-10**、**版本號 **983****、**許可 **CC BY 4.0****、**可用性評分 **0.82****、**下載 **1,767 次、**瀏覽 **7,728 次、**收藏 **35**；**標籤逐字含** `business`、`economics`、`time series analysis`、`global`、`covid19`、`diseases`、`mortality`**；**⚠️ 而**體量在兩個介面上**不一致**（**10,451,025,952 位元組 對 約 **2.85 GB****）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：鏡像**」**——**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **版本號 **983****；**② **上游的**解讀告誡被一起搬過來****；**③ **逐字寫明**哪兩個國家從未報告****。**⚠️ 本次未下載任何檔案、**未訪問上游倉庫。
e.summary_en: The Kaggle dataset covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates **is a daily mirror of an upstream excess-mortality model output**, subtitled as daily updates of a newspaper excess deaths dataset and giving the upstream repository address. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-10**, **version 983**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, **a usability rating of about 0.82**, one thousand seven hundred and sixty-seven downloads, seven thousand seven hundred and twenty-eight views and thirty-five votes, tagged with business, economics, time series analysis, global, covid, diseases and mortality, and **a size that the two public endpoints state differently** at about ten gigabytes and about two point eight five gigabytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case a mirror**, and **three things are worth reading: a version counter in the hundreds shows that this is a moving line rather than a snapshot; the upstream interpretation warnings are carried across with the data, including the instruction to report the ninety-five percent range when ranges are not narrow and the warning that focusing on central estimates would be misleading; and the two countries that have never reported are named**. **No file was downloaded and the upstream repository was not visited.**
e.body:
**global-excess-deaths-mirror**（Kaggle 数据集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`，**逐字标题** `Covid19 Global Excess Deaths (daily updates)`**）**是一份**自动跟随上游模型输出的超额死亡每日镜像****——**逐字副标题为**「**Daily updates of the Economist的 Covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**，**并逐字给出上游仓库地址**「**from the Economist的 GitHub repository: `TheEconomist/covid-19-the-economist-global-excess-deaths-model`**」**。**本次实测**：**最后更新 2026-09-10**、**版本号 **983****、**可用性评分 **0.82****、**下载 **1,767 次、**浏览 **7,728 次、**收藏 **35、**公开 notebook 2 个**；**所有者与创建者为同一人**（`Joakim Arvidsson`**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**数据的来路：镜像**」**。

**⭐ 引号约定**：**本条目所引英文专名与作品名中原为 ASCII 撇号者一律写成弯撇号**（**U+2019**）**。

**可核实信息（均 Kaggle 数据集页元数据与描述实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 许可与版本号写明这是一条**每天推进的线****——**实测**许可字段逐字为**「**Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**」**，**而**版本号逐字为 **983****（**⭐ 即**同一份数据集**已经被**连续更新九百多次**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**版本号本身是一条信息****：**⭐ 即**「**这不是一份做好的数据集**」**，**而是一条**跟着上游模型每天重算的线**——**⭐ 这与本站第 353 轮「**同源多形**」、第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」同向**：**当你收录的是一份**镜像**时，**必须**说清它**跟着谁、**多久变一次**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 上游的**解读告诫**被一起搬过来**——**逐字**：**「**Estimating excess deaths for every country every day since the pandemic began is a complex and difficult task. Rather than being overly confident in a single number, limited data means that we can often only give a very very wide range of plausible values. **Focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading: unless ranges are very narrow, the 95% range should be reported when possible.** The ranges assume that the conditions for bootstrap confidence intervals are met.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**镜像**通常只搬数字**，**而这一份**把上游的**「**别只看中心值**」**一起搬了**——**⭐ 这与本站第 347 轮「**防误读**」、第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**当一份数据**主要是区间**而不是点估计**时，**告诫**是数据的一部分**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它还逐字写明**哪些国家没有数据、**为什么****——**逐字**：**「**Turkmenistan and the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea have not reported any covid-19 figures since the start of the pandemic. They also have not published all-cause mortality data. **Exports of estimates for the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea have been temporarily disabled as it now issues contradictory data**: reporting a significant outbreak through its state media, but zero confirmed covid-19 cases/deaths to the WHO.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**这一列为什么是空**」**被写成**一句有名有姓的说明**，**而**且**包含一处**主动停发**（**逐字** temporarily disabled**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」同向**：**缺席**不是**空白**，**而是**有原因的状态**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它把**不确定性的适用范围**也写明**——**逐字**：**关于变异株**「**The Omicron variant appears to have characteristics that are different to earlier versions of sars-cov-2. Where this variant is now dominant, this change makes estimates uncertain beyond the ranges indicated. Other new variants may do the same. As more data is incorporated from places where new variants are dominant, predictions improve.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**区间之外还有不确定性**」**这一句**被主动写出来**——**⭐ 本词条认为这与**第 3 点**合起来构成**一份罕见完整的**数据说明书**：**数值、**区间、**缺席、**以及**区间本身何时不够用**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 上游的**方法归属**被逐字给出**——**逐字**：**① **拟合算法**「**The gradient booster implementation used to fit the models is aGTBoost**」**；**② **作者**「**All coding and data collection to construct these models (and make them update dynamically) was done by Sondre Ulvund Solstad.**」**，**并逐字给出联系方式**（**推为**对应的作者邮箱**）**；**③ **致谢**列出一串人名（**含** Ariel Karlinsky、**Philip Schellekens** 等**）**；**④ **建议引用格式**逐字为**「**The Economist and Solstad, S. (corresponding author), 2021. The pandemic**弯撇号**s true death toll. [online] The Economist.**」**，**并逐字写明**首次发表于 **2021 年第 20 期的一篇文章**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组值得抄**：**⭐ 即**一份**由媒体机构产出的估算**，**把**算法、**作者、**致谢与引用格式**都放进了数据集说明里**——**⭐ 而**这正是**学术使用者**最需要的东西**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 开放修改也被写明**——**逐字**：**「**Calculating excess deaths for the entire world over multiple years is both complex and imprecise. **We welcome any suggestions on how to improve the model, be it data, algorithm, or logic. If you have one, please open an issue.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**如何提出修正**」被指向**上游的 issue 流程**——**⭐ 这与本站第 337 轮「**没有任何东西站在单一来源上**」同向**：**一个估算**要能被质询**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 一处**两个接口不一致**（本次实测）**：**⭐ 数据集页接口给出总字节 **10,451,025,952**（**约 10.45 GB**）**，**而**列表接口给出约 **2.85 GB**（**2,850.54 MB**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个数字而不替它调和**，**并指出**这正是**镜像类数据集**常见的现象**（**⭐ 体量随版本变化，**而两个接口**不一定取同一版本**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[rki-excess-mortality]] 覆盖德国官方超额死亡报告数据**，**[[excessmort]] 覆盖 R 的超额死亡建模包**，**[[lost-years]] 覆盖寿命损失年**，**[[who-gho]]、**[[ihme-gbd]] 覆盖全球卫生观测与疾病负担**，**[[human-mortality-db]] 覆盖历史死亡率数据**，**[[mortality-analysis-provenance]] 覆盖死亡率分析的证据分栏**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**第三方镜像**：**每天跟随上游模型、**并把上游的区间告诫、**缺席说明与引用格式一并搬过来**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[rki-excess-mortality]]、[[excessmort]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① **镜像要写明它跟着谁、**多久变一次、**版本号是多少**；**② **上游的解读告诫**应当与数值一起搬运**；**③ **数据为空时要写清**原因**（**含**主动停发**）**；**④ **区间之外的不确定性**也要写出来**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有下载该数据集的任何文件**（**未取任何 CSV 或版本、**未复算任何国家的超额死亡估计**），**故**不主张**其任何数值结果**（**⭐ 包括各年各国的中心估计与 95% 区间**）**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未访问上游仓库**（`TheEconomist/covid-19-the-economist-global-excess-deaths-model`**）**，**也未读其方法学页面**；**⭐ 本词条所转述的一切告诫、**归属与引用格式**都只来自 Kaggle 数据集页的描述**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**上游仓库**是否仍在维护、**以及**其最新版本与本镜像的版本是否同步**（**⭐ 描述称**每天更新**，**但本次**未核对该时间序列**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**上述两个体量数字**孰为准**（**⭐ 本词条**只并列**）**；**⭐ 也未核实** 983 **这一版本号是否对应**真正的更新次数**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**区间基于自助法置信区间的前提**」**这一表述**在方法学上**是否准确**（**⭐ 只转述描述**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** Turkmenistan **与** DPRK **的实际情况**（**⭐ 本词条只转述描述与上游的说法，**不对任何国家的数据发布状况作判断**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** aGTBoost **这一实现**（**⭐ 描述称它是用于拟合的梯度提升实现**，**本次**未查证**）**；**也未核实**其许可**。**⑧ ⚠️ **许可与使用**：**⭐ 本数据集页的许可字段为** CC BY 4.0**（**须署名**）**；**⚠️ 而**其内容**来自上游**（**媒体机构与具名作者的模型**）**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**引用时**应使用**描述中给出的建议引用格式**，**而不只引 Kaggle 页面**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核实** Kaggle **下载是否需要登录**；**也未核实**该数据集是否包含**派生列或仅上游原样输出**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目的**性质**须说清**：**它**不是**一个模型或工具**，**而是**一份**跟随上游的镜像数据集**（**⭐ 据此把 `kind` 记为** `dataset`**）**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目的**主题相关性**须如实说明**：**⭐ 它属于**死亡率方向**（**而非保险定价或准备金**）**，**其被收录是因为**超额死亡**是寿险与年金研究的常用输入**，**而**本条的核心价值在**镜像与告诫的搬运方式**，**不在**其数值本身**。**⑫ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 最后更新 **2026-09-10**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**；**⚠️ 而其上游模型**自 **2021** 年起持续更新**，**本条收录的是**在窗口内被更新到的那一版**，**而不是**一份新数据集**。**⑬ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。
e.body_hk:
**global-excess-deaths-mirror**（Kaggle 資料集 `joebeachcapital/covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates`，**逐字標題** `Covid19 Global Excess Deaths (daily updates)`**）**是一份**自動跟隨上游模型輸出的超額死亡每日鏡像****——**逐字副標題為**「**Daily updates of the Economist的 Covid19 Global Excess Deaths data**」**，**並逐字給出上游倉庫地址**「**from the Economist的 GitHub repository: `TheEconomist/covid-19-the-economist-global-excess-deaths-model`**」**。**本次實測**：**最後更新 2026-09-10**、**版本號 **983****、**可用性評分 **0.82****、**下載 **1,767 次、**瀏覽 **7,728 次、**收藏 **35、**公開 notebook 2 個**；**所有者與創建者同為一人**（`Joakim Arvidsson`**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**資料的來路：鏡像**」**。

**⭐ 引號約定**：**本條目所引英文專名與作品名中原為 ASCII 撇號者一律寫成彎撇號**（**U+2019**）**。

**可核實資訊（均 Kaggle 資料集頁元資料與描述實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 許可與版本號寫明這是一條**每天推進的線****——**許可欄位逐字為**「**Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**」**，**版本號逐字為 983****（**⭐ 即**同一份資料集已被連續更新九百多次**）**。**⭐ **版本號本身是一條資訊****：**這不是一份做好的資料集**，**而是一條跟著上游模型每天重算的線**——**⭐ 收錄鏡像時必須說清它**跟著誰、**多久變一次****。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 上游的**解讀告誡**被一起搬過來****——**逐字**「**Rather than being overly confident in a single number, limited data means that we can often only give a very very wide range of plausible values. Focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading: unless ranges are very narrow, the 95% range should be reported when possible. The ranges assume that the conditions for bootstrap confidence intervals are met.**」**——**⭐ 即**鏡像通常只搬數字**，**而這一份**把上游的「**別只看中心值**」**一起搬了**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 逐字寫明**哪些國家沒有資料、**為什麼****——**逐字**「**Turkmenistan and the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea have not reported any covid-19 figures since the start of the pandemic. They also have not published all-cause mortality data. Exports of estimates for the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea have been temporarily disabled as it now issues contradictory data: reporting a significant outbreak through its state media, but zero confirmed covid-19 cases/deaths to the WHO.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**這一列為什麼是空**」**被寫成一句有名有姓的說明**，**且**包含一處**主動停發****。**⭐⭐ ④ 不確定性的適用範圍也寫明**——**逐字**「**The Omicron variant appears to have characteristics that are different to earlier versions of sars-cov-2. Where this variant is now dominant, this change makes estimates uncertain beyond the ranges indicated.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**區間之外還有不確定性**」**被主動寫出**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 上游的**方法歸屬**逐字給出**：**擬合算法** aGTBoost**；**作者** All coding and data collection to construct these models (and make them update dynamically) was done by Sondre Ulvund Solstad**；**致謝**一串人名**；**建議引用格式**逐字為**「**The Economist and Solstad, S. (corresponding author), 2021. The pandemic**彎撇號**s true death toll.**」**，**並逐字寫明首發於 **2021 年第 20 期一篇文章**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 開放修改寫明**——**逐字**「**We welcome any suggestions on how to improve the model, be it data, algorithm, or logic. If you have one, please open an issue.**」**——**⭐ 即**修正路徑指向上游 issue 流程**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 一處**兩個介面不一致**（本次實測）**：**資料集頁給 **10,451,025,952 位元組**（**約 10.45 GB**）**，**列表介面給約 **2.85 GB**（**2,850.54 MB**）**——**⭐ 如實並列而不替它調和**，**並指出這是**鏡像類資料集**常見現象**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 與池內條目的關係**：[[rki-excess-mortality]]、[[excessmort]]、[[lost-years]]、[[who-gho]]、[[ihme-gbd]]、[[human-mortality-db]]、[[mortality-analysis-provenance]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**第三方鏡像：每天跟隨上游模型＋把上游的區間告誡、**缺席說明與引用格式一併搬過來**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[rki-excess-mortality]]、[[excessmort]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 四點最值得借鑑**：**① **鏡像要寫明跟著誰、**多久變一次、**版本號多少**；**② **上游的解讀告誡**應與數值一起搬運**；**③ **資料為空時要寫清**原因**（**含主動停發**）**；**④ **區間之外的不確定性**也要寫出**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有下載該資料集任何檔案**（**未取任何 CSV 或版本、**未複算任何國家的超額死亡估計**），**不主張**其任何數值結果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未訪問上游倉庫**，**也未讀其方法學頁面**；**⭐ 本條所轉述的告誡、**歸屬與引用格式**都只來自 Kaggle 描述**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**上游是否仍在維護、**以及**其最新版本與本鏡像是否同步**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**上述兩個體量數字**孰為準****（**只並列**）**；**未核實 **983** 這一版本號是否對應真正的更新次數**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**「**區間基於自助法前提**」**這一表述在方法學上是否準確**（**只轉述描述**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實** Turkmenistan **與** DPRK **的實際情況**（**⭐ 只轉述描述與上游說法，**不對任何國家的資料發布狀況作判斷**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實** aGTBoost **這一實現與其許可**。**⑧ ⚠️ **許可與使用**：**本資料集頁許可為** CC BY 4.0**（**須署名**）**；**⚠️ 而**其內容來自上游**（**媒體機構與具名作者的模型**）**——**⭐ 引用時應使用**描述中給出的建議引用格式**，**而不只引 Kaggle 頁面**。**⑨ ⚠️ 未核實** Kaggle **下載是否需要登入**；**未核實**其是否含派生欄位**。**⑩ ⚠️ **性質**須說清**：**它不是**模型或工具**，**而是**跟隨上游的鏡像資料集**（**⭐ `kind` 記為 `dataset`**）**。**⑪ ⚠️ **主題相關性**如實說明**：**⭐ 屬**死亡率方向**（**而非保險定價或準備金**）**，**收錄原因是**超額死亡是壽險與年金研究的常用輸入**，**而**核心價值在**鏡像與告誡的搬運方式**。**⑫ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**最後更新 2026-09-10（**窗口內**）**；**⚠️ 上游模型自 2021 年起持續更新**，**本條收錄的是**窗口內被更新到的那一版**。**⑬ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。

The Kaggle dataset covid19-global-excess-deaths-daily-updates, titled as excess deaths with daily updates, **is a daily mirror of an upstream excess-mortality model output**, subtitled as daily updates of a newspaper excess deaths dataset and giving the upstream repository address verbatim. **Measured this round**: **last updated 2026-09-10**, **version 983**, **a usability rating of about 0.82**, one thousand seven hundred and sixty-seven downloads, seven thousand seven hundred and twenty-eight views, thirty-five votes and two public notebooks, owned and created by the same person. **This entry belongs to the round theme of where data comes from, in this case a mirror.**

**Quotation convention**: apostrophes inside quoted English proper names and titles are reproduced with a typographic apostrophe so that they are distinguishable from the quotation marks of this entry itself.

**Verified information, all measured from the dataset page metadata and description**: **first, the licence and the version number show that this is a moving line rather than a finished dataset**: the licence field reads as a Creative Commons attribution licence, while the version counter stands at nine hundred and eighty-three, meaning the same dataset has been updated several hundred times in sequence. **When what is collected is a mirror rather than an original, the version counter itself is information: it says who is being followed and how often the content changes.** **Second, the upstream interpretation warnings are carried across with the data**: verbatim, rather than being overly confident in a single number, limited data often permits only a very wide range of plausible values, focusing on central estimates in such cases would be misleading, the ninety-five percent range should be reported when possible unless ranges are very narrow, and the ranges assume that the conditions for bootstrap confidence intervals are met. **A mirror usually carries only numbers; this one carries the upstream instruction not to look at the central estimate alone, which matters because a dataset that is mostly an interval should be read as an interval.** **Third, the countries with no data and the reasons are stated verbatim**: two named countries have not reported any figures since the start of the pandemic and have not published all-cause mortality data, and exports of estimates for one of them have been temporarily disabled because it now issues contradictory data, reporting a significant outbreak through state media while reporting zero confirmed cases and deaths to the world health organisation. **Why a column is empty is written as a statement with names in it, including a case where publication was deliberately suspended, which is the difference between an absence and a blank.** **Fourth, the scope of the uncertainty is also stated**: verbatim, a later variant appears to have characteristics different from earlier versions, and where that variant is now dominant the change makes estimates uncertain beyond the ranges indicated, while other new variants may do the same. **Numbers, intervals, absences and the conditions under which the intervals themselves stop being sufficient together make an unusually complete data note.** **Fifth, the upstream method attribution is given item by item**: the gradient boosting implementation used to fit the models is named; all coding and data collection including the dynamic updating is attributed to a named author with contact details; a list of acknowledgements is given; and a suggested citation is provided verbatim naming the newspaper and the author with the year and article title, together with the issue in which it first appeared. **A media-produced estimate that places its algorithm, author, acknowledgements and citation format inside the dataset description gives academic users exactly what they need.** **Sixth, the route for corrections is stated**: verbatim, calculating excess deaths for the entire world over multiple years is both complex and imprecise, and suggestions on data, algorithm or logic are welcome through the upstream issue tracker. **A correction path pointing at the upstream tracker is what lets an estimate be challenged.** **Seventh, one inconsistency between two endpoints was measured**: the dataset page reports a total of about ten gigabytes while the listing endpoint reports about two point eight five gigabytes, and this entry records both without reconciling them, noting that this is a common feature of mirrored datasets whose size changes with the version and whose endpoints may not be read at the same version. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover an official national excess-mortality report, an R package for excess-mortality modelling, years of life lost, global health observation and burden-of-disease data, historical mortality data and a provenance framework for mortality analysis, **while this entry supplies a third-party mirror that follows an upstream model daily and carries the upstream interval warnings, absence explanations and citation format across with the numbers. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled national excess-mortality data and the pooled excess-mortality modelling package**; **four practices transfer directly: a mirror should state who it follows, how often it changes and what version it is on; upstream interpretation warnings should be carried with the numbers; when a column is empty, say why, including cases of deliberate suspension; and uncertainty beyond the stated interval should be written down too**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no file from the dataset was downloaded** — no version, no table and no recomputation of any country excess-mortality estimate — **so no numerical result is claimed, including any central estimate or interval**. **Second, the upstream repository was not visited and its methodology page was not read**: everything relayed here about warnings, attribution and citation format comes from the dataset page description alone; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the upstream is still maintained and whether its latest version matches this mirror were not verified**, the description stating daily updates without the time series being checked. **Fourth, which of the two stated sizes is correct was not verified**, both being recorded side by side, nor was it verified whether the version counter corresponds to the number of real updates. **Fifth, whether the statement that the ranges rest on bootstrap confidence interval conditions is methodologically accurate was not verified**, this entry relaying the description. **Sixth, the actual reporting situation of the two named countries was not verified**, and this entry relays the upstream account without making any judgement about any country data publication. **Seventh, the named gradient boosting implementation and its licence were not verified. Eighth, on licensing and use**: the dataset page is licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence, while the content comes from an upstream model by a media organisation and a named author, so **citations should follow the suggested format in the description rather than citing only the dataset page**. **Ninth, whether downloading requires signing in was not verified, nor was it checked whether the mirror adds derived columns or reproduces the upstream output unchanged. Tenth, the nature of this item must be stated plainly**: it is not a model or a tool but a mirror dataset following an upstream, and its kind is recorded as a dataset. **Eleventh, its topical relevance should be stated honestly**: it sits on the mortality side rather than in insurance pricing or reserving, it is collected because excess mortality is a customary input to life and annuity research, and **its value here lies in how the mirror carries the warnings, not in the numbers themselves**. **Twelfth, on the window: the last update was 2026-09-10, inside the thaw window, while the upstream model has been updating since 2021, so what is collected is the version current inside the window rather than a newly created dataset. Thirteenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
